game.name: Stranglehold (Europe, Australia)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Stranglehold is an action game for Xbox 360. You play as Chow Yun-Fat, aka Tequila, a Hong Kong policeman, during seven different missions. Between honour, love, betrayal and revenge, use the weapons at your disposal to annihilate the countless masses of enemies who want your skin. It is also possible to use "Tequila Time", which is based on Bullet Time.
